pages.text: The $(l)Volcanite Amulet$() is a bottomless bucket of lava. Craft it from lava buckets and Dark Matter. It fits the necklace curio slot.$(br2)Right-click a block to place lava for 32 EMC, and press $(l)R$() to fire a lava orb.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)It makes you immune to fire while carried.$(li)While carried you can walk on lava and you move faster over it, like the Evertide Amulet does on water.$(li)The $(l)R$() lava orb does not charge when fired; it costs 32 EMC only when it hits a block (placing lava) or a creature (burning it).$(li)As it flies it turns water into stone or obsidian.$(li)On a pedestal it stops rain and storms on a timer.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() server.cooldown.pedestal.volcanite.
